title: Fourier-transform spectrometer — 1800 l/mm grating
description: The Fourier-transform spectrometer is a spectrometer specified here at 1800 l/mm grating. Coma: off-axis rays in the collimator smear the spectral lines. Astigmatism: perpendicular planes focus at different points; the classic Czerny-Turner limitation. Corrected with aspherical lens elements. Typical use: chemistry quality control.
